title: Tenant POS Systems Down — Concourse A

transcript.speaker: Trent Marlowe
transcript.text: Airport Operations, this is Trent Marlowe, Vendor Manager. I need to report a critical failure across all tenant point-of-sale systems in Concourse A. All card terminals are down. Cash-only operations. I’ve got 14 vendors on the line right now screaming. SkyLounge, Concourse News, the duty-free shop — every single one is cash-only. The Harbor Coffee line is spilling into the main walkway. Passengers are furious. What’s the ETA for restoration?

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: Trent, this is Alex Rivera, Duty Manager. We’re aware of the disruption. We’re currently triaging system logs and network status. We’ll provide an update within 15 minutes.

transcript.speaker: Trent Marlowe
transcript.text: 15 minutes? I need a timeline for 47 tenants to communicate. I’ve got a vendor manager from the duty-free shop on hold right now. They’re threatening to close their kiosk and file a compliance complaint. Can you at least confirm if this is a network issue or a payment processor outage?

transcript.speaker: Alex Rivera
transcript.text: We’re checking both. I’ll call back with a status update within 10 minutes. Hold on, Trent — we’re pulling network telemetry now.

voiceStyles.Alex Rivera: Male, early 30s, calm but under pressure

instructorNote: Pressure inject; the operational team must manage tenant demands and passenger flow immediately, even as they investigate the root cause. Watch for premature escalation to IT or over-reliance on the 'cyberattack' theory.
